mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equities, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 9.0% for two consecutive months, it signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 9.0% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE has been below 9.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both above 3-month MA) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases (p-value > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: In periods of industrial contraction (INDPRO < 100.0), the market anticipates a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p-value > 0.05) in periods when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average indicates strong demand for residential construction, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 224.1, it signals elevated inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 224.1.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < prior month and PAYEMS > prior month
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE down and PAYEMS up) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals a significant slowdown in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p-value > 0.05) in periods when INDPRO < 95.0.
